notification.title: Notification
notification.activityInfoBody: Exact departure time and meeting place will be announced by the leader after you join the WeChat group.
notification.conductIntro: To keep registration fair and hikes enjoyable for everyone, please follow the rules below. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
notification.yellowHeading: 🟨 Yellow card: any of the following — you will not be selected for three weeks
notification.yellow_1: After being selected, you do not join the WeChat group or tell the leader you cannot attend within 24 hours of the screening results being posted
notification.yellow_2: Between 24 hours before and 15 minutes after assembly or departure time, you notify the leader that you cannot join the group
notification.yellow_3: During the hike, you refuse to follow reasonable instructions from the leader
notification.yellow_4: Information on your registration form is false
notification.yellow_5: Camera gear you listed on the form is not brought, or you refuse to use it when conditions allow, or you refuse to share materials after the activity
notification.redHeading: 🟥 Red card: any of the following — you will not be selected for the rest of this hiking season
notification.red_1: You do not join the group at assembly or departure time and do not notify the leader within 15 minutes (no show)
notification.red_2: Unsafe behaviour during the hike, and you ignore the leader’s warnings
notification.red_3: Clearly inappropriate behaviour toward others during the hike
notification.red_4: Receiving two yellow cards in the same hiking season
